text:
alexc: Heads-up — ran a focused profile against /v1/chat/stream this morning and saw a recurring latency spike for small batches (~1-4 requests). Kernel selector is routing those to the fallback nvcc path and we're also seeing a KV cache hit-rate dip on the same traces. attaching quick notes and a flame snippet.

marta: oof. did the kernel selector log which rule matched? last week we added a sequence-length heuristic, maybe it's firing too aggressively.

alexc: yes, selector log shows `rule: small_batch_cpu_fallback` even when GPU load was <40%. suspect the recent change that downranks fp16 kernels for tiny seqs is too aggressive.

samir: can you paste the flame? also curious if prefix KV misses correlate with the fallback decisions.

alexc: pasted below
```
# flame excerpt
kernel_choice: nvcc_fallback @ 0x... (latency 8-12ms)
kv_get: miss @ prefix_id abc123
kv_get: miss @ prefix_id abc123
batching_coalesce: delayed 11ms
```

leah: two hypotheses: 1) batching heuristics are not coalescing because requests are tagged with micro-session ids (so not eligible for merging), 2) KV cache key normalization regressed and misses make the runtime compute longer contexts which then trigger selector heuristics.

marta: good call. @samir can you check batching logs for `micro-session` tag behavior across that timeframe? we added that tagging for telemetry but didn't whitelist it for merging.

samir: on it. initial grep shows ~32% of small requests had `X-MICRO-SESSION` header set. also saw `coalesce_threshold_ms` bumped to 10ms in latest deploy (PR #2389) — that would increase wait time and could cause the delay noted.

nina: from the dashboards: route `chat-stream` unit-cost-per-token exploded for that window. not just latency — cost attribution shows more kernels charged per token due to fallback and extra KV lookups. link: https://flightdeck.internal/dash/rdw-672

alexc: exactly. we need a two-part fix: a) revert or soften small-seq kernel downrank; b) make batching ignore `X-MICRO-SESSION` for eligible workloads. also add instrumentation: per-token latency breakdown that ties each token to a kernel selection and a KV hit/miss flag so we can reconcile cost-of-serving with billing logs.

samir: implemented a quick probe patch locally to tag tokens with `kernel_id` + `kv_hit` in trace spans. sample output:
```
trace_token: { token_idx: 3, kernel: "fp16_opt_v2", kv_hit: true, latency_ms: 0.8 }
```
This lets us build a histogram of kernel-level per-token latency.

marta: great. for dashboards we should expose: median per-token by kernel, p95 per-route, % tokens routed to fallback, and an estimated unit charge delta (kernel_cost * tokens) so finance can see the impact.

leah: small ask — when you add token-level tags, keep the span size bounded. avoid storing full token text; just index/ids and booleans. otherwise traces will blow up and increase storage costs.

alexc: noted. proposal for rollout: feature-flag the extra span fields, collect 1% traffic for 24h, run join of traces -> billing (billing side team to provide token-charge table). create a short-lived bucket of trace artifacts and auto-delete after 30d.

marta: create infra ticket and dashboard mock. I'll own the kernel-selector revert if we agree on canary criteria (no regression in throughput at 5% sample).

samir: i'll patch batching to ignore `X-MICRO-SESSION` for endpoints in `coalesce_allowlist`. testing locally now.

deploy-bot: deploy queued by marta for `kernel-selector-revert` -> staging at 1918456075

nina: financial ops: I can provide the mapping of kernel ids -> unit charge. will also add a reconciliation query to compare observed token-charges with raw billing. SQL stub:
```
SELECT route, sum(tokens * kernel_unit_cost) as estimated_cost, sum(billing_charge) as billed
FROM token_charges
JOIN billing.raw_charges USING (request_id)
GROUP BY route
```

leah: perfect. next steps: samir finish batching patch, alexc enable 1% token tagging, marta canary revert on staging -> 1% prod after 6h smoke, nina run reconciliation once we have 24h of samples. I'll open a short lived incident chat if we see >10% delta between estimated_cost and billed.

alexc: created ticket INFRA-1426 with runbook and links to the flame and the flightdeck view. thanks folks :thumbsup:

marta: thanks, will update PRs and post results here.

samir: batching patch merged to canary at 1918456110, running perf harness now.

nina: FYI finance pulled an initial diff — estimated_cost during the spike window was ~34% higher than billed (billing lag may account for some). we'll iterate.

alexc: closing loop once canary is green. otherwise escalate to runtime oncall.
